PostToolUse.command: bash -c 'FILE="$TOOL_INPUT"; if [[ "$FILE" == */src/* ]] || [[ "$FILE" == */app/* ]]; then if [[ "$FILE" != *test* ]] && [[ "$FILE" != *spec* ]] && [[ "$FILE" != *.md ]] && [[ "$FILE" != *.json ]] && [[ "$FILE" != *.config* ]]; then echo "[Auto-test] Smoke test triggered by edit to $FILE"; cd /home/jakob/endall-web && npm test --watchAll=false 2>&1 | tail -15; fi; fi'
